note: Inyo County campground on Independence Creek a mile west of Independence on Onion Valley Rd (Market St from US-395). Sites 2-14 line the road a short walk from the creek; the far bank (16-29) is reached over a bridge, which is damaged: those sites are closed until further notice. --Claude
